_comment: Written by src/scripts/record_evaluator_measurements.mjs, invoked from src/scripts/evaluator_umbrella.sh when UMBRELLA_RECORD=1 (the nightly). check_evaluator_budgets.ts --recorded compares a fresh measurement set against this file; a contradiction on a DETERMINISTIC metric warns on main and fails on release. Do not hand-edit — refresh it from a real run.
conditions: Refresh for the 20 -> 25 mcp_public_tool_count move: the five graph_* MCP tools (graph_impact, graph_tests_for, graph_dead, graph_query, graph_path) shipped in 9452f29b4 (road-to-a-graph-that-is-shipped Phase 4.1) and the registering PR did not move the budget, so the release gate blocked. Re-measured three times via the pinned method (tools/list length on a freshly built dist/mcp/server.mjs, npm run build:mcp-bundle on this tree): 25/25/25, the name set differing from the 20-tool set by exactly the five graph_* entries. cli_help_command_count is carried forward unchanged at 110 -- re-measured via the pinned method (registry enumeration) on this tree: 110. Measured locally on darwin/arm64 node v26.7.0 rather than in the umbrella container; both metrics are tree-derived and container-independent.
